identity.title: Recent Progress in High-Mass Star-Formation Studies with ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: This review summarizes the scientific highlights for high-mass star-formation studies with ALMA obtained from the beginning of the ALMA regular operation in 2011 to the time of the East Asian ALMA science workshop 2017, November.

evidence.quote: even the nearest site of high-mass star-formation, i.e. Orion Molecular Cloud, is located three times larger distance of 420 pc.

question.value: What has ALMA contributed to high-mass star-formation studies (filaments/clumps/cores, disks and outflows, chemistry, masers and accretion bursts)?

evidence.quote: It should be noted that only representative observational results from ALMA are presented in this review.

what.value: Enclosed mass of Orion Source I 8.7±0.6 Msun and centrifugal radii 21-47 AU from Si18O position-velocity diagram

evidence.quote: The position-velocity diagram suggests an enclosed mass of 8.7$\pm$0.6$M_{\odot}$ and centrifugal radii of 21-47 AU.

unstated_but_needed: This is a review; no data reduction or analysis recipe is given. Reproduction would require the original papers.

findings_qualitative.value: ALMA resolves 100-1000 AU disks and outflows around high-mass YSOs, with evidence of disk accretion and magnetically driven outflows analogous to low-mass star formation.

evidence.quote: These results show strong evidences of the accretion through disks and magnetically driven outflows which are analogous to low-mass star-formation.

claims.hypothesis: Does ALMA provide evidence on high-mass star-formation scenarios (turbulent core vs competitive accretion)?
claims.experiment: Literature review of ALMA studies of IRDC cores, protoclusters, disks, outflows, chemistry, masers
claims.result: Observations give mixed results favoring either model; few high-mass starless cores are confirmed
claims.finding: More statistical, uniform datasets are needed to decide the dominant process

evidence.quote: more statistical datasets would be necessary to judge which is the more dominant processes in high-mass star-formation.

limitations_admitted.value: Observations are limited to case studies; resolution insufficient for innermost regions.

evidence.quote: observations are still limited for case studies of well know sources, and spatial resolutions are insufficient to resolve the innermost regions

referee_caveats_inferred: Review: selective coverage, no quantitative synthesis.

reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: No methods or numeric results of its own.
